Q1.decision: Three phases, 18 tasks; bounded text-only adaptation on installed gemma4:12b. A blocked runtime may yield HOLD without a quality verdict. No Humanizer installation, adapter/catalog changes or Handwired implementation.

Q2.decision: Eight outputs per language: four edit-needed and four clean controls; zero factual changes, exact/structure obligations, edit-needed readability at least 4 with at least one-point improvement and declared goal met, clean controls preserve voice without regression.

Q3.decision: Locally record self-attested proficiency in professional writing and checking meaning per reviewed language; qualify only completed reviews and hold unavailable languages. No hosted judge or guessed approval.

Q4.decision: Add the v2.14.1 tracker section and 0/18 metric plus Rewrite adaptation and Literal obligation terms, preserving every existing entry.

finalDisposition.note: Initial raw findings and confidence values are retained; final dispositions reflect the approved decisions, not runtime verification.
